title: Hindi basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken Hindi (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/hi/rank.mjs), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out. Each word has its romanisation, one short everyday sentence that uses it the way native speakers do, and its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word. Verbs are given in their dictionary form (-ना). The voice is a woman's, so sentences with मैं (I) use the forms a woman says (मैं जाती हूँ; a man says मैं जाता हूँ).
